items.capability: In-place hypervisor update from the SPA with A/B slots and rollback
items.note: Branch `cursor/wave-6-a7-update-0591`. Two 4 MiB slots on the spare, header 4 GiB below the NIC catalog, under the Ubuntu library and above the 10 GiB guest tail. `GET /host/update`, `POST /host/update/rollback`, `POST /host/update/confirm`, chunked `POST /host/update/chunk/{off}/{total}`. Rollback drops a pending slot. Confirm keeps it after the spare write. Guest config (C8) is not moved. UBUNTU0 is refused. LBA 0 is refused. The spare write is one sector at a time between guest VM exits, so the guest keeps running. Confirm sets `apply` on that slot. The next boot, before ExitBootServices, reads the slot through firmware Block I/O and replaces `EFI/BOOT/BOOTX64.EFI` on the loaded volume, after saving `EFI/BOOT/BOOTX64.OLD`. The Toshiba durable LUN is not written. The boot after that file lands is the one that runs the new image. Roll back then arms the following boot to copy `BOOTX64.OLD` back over `BOOTX64.EFI`. Lived 2026-11-05. From `fa3f4860c6a7` / run `42096983983`, Keep copied slot 1 (`boot: A7 stick wrote bytes=2599968`). The next boot was `build: sha=318c6617c99b run=42133864880` and Overview said `old saved`. Roll back then `boot: A7 stick restored bytes=2599968`, `boot: A7 stick restore clear`, and `boot: A7 wr lba=6181880318 match` before autostart. The following F11 was `build: sha=fa3f4860c6a7 run=42096983983` with no second restore. SPA: Guest 3 running, `active 1 · pending none · durable yes`. Signed `318c6617` SHA256 `7cca349c07b7a435ec665d97db4718c6865a749ceaa93c1193a3b4e144000095`. Evidence `docs/evidence/r640/2026-11-05-fa3f4860c6a7-wave-6-a7-rollback-ok.md`. The lived images still waited for the guest to stop before the spare write. `d0904bf8` writes that spare while the guest keeps running and was not this F11.

items.note: Iron `e6ed42a31ba4` / run `40938025112`. Boot next wrote `boot: B5 autostart wr lba=6190268909 match`. The next F11, with the SPA never opened, printed `boot: B5 autostart rd lba=6190268909 n=1` and `boot: B5 autostart start off=19327352832`, then the tail boot and `raynusrv2 login:`. That COM2 PCI probe had virtio-blk `00:02.0` and no virtio-net `00:05.0`; `systemd-networkd-wait-online` failed because this start did not call `on_accepted_start`. The branch now does, and prints `boot: B5 autostart nic` or `nic none`. That line is not on this COM2. Evidence `docs/evidence/r640/2026-10-29-e6ed42a3-wave-4-b5-autostart-ok.md`. items.capability: Multiple concurrent guests on one R640
items.note: Branch `cursor/wave-7-b6-seats-37d7`. Lab iron already printed `RAYNU-V-M4-2VM-OK` for the small G0/G1 guests. A product Start while another product guest owns the VMCS seats the second guest and does not retarget the running guest's disk or NIC. Stop then boots that seated guest on the same VMCS (`promote_parked`). While a companion is seated, `product_pair` counts a primary slice every 8192 Linux exits, and one extra VMCS then runs `HLT` on its own page tables and VMRESUMEs the guest that was already on the CPU. A failed entry leaves that guest running. The `HLT` does not move the companion counter. The close line stays silent until both product guests have been entered. Not lived. Not an F11 until two product guests both make progress on the R640

items.capability: Guest interrupt controller beyond 8259: IOAPIC/LAPIC, MSI/MSI-X for virtio
items.note: Iron `8f69297c69a8` / run `42398077199`, pull-request merge of `d0a0d7cf`. Signed SHA256 `ee32b9db82c8a682833a1fbb5e3a18bbe0f014963e84d1a2a5ce5eb5e030e6e0`. `boot: B4 acpi rsdp gpa=0x804000 (power button, PCI0 IRQ 11, MADT local APIC and I/O APIC)`. Linux: `ACPI: APIC 0x804340`, `IOAPIC[0]: apic_id 0, version 17, address 0xfec00000, GSI 0-23`, `INT_SRC_OVR bus_irq 0 global_irq 2`, `Using ACPI (MADT) for SMP configuration information`, `Switch to symmetric I/O mode setup`, `Using IOAPIC for interrupt routing`. Disk MSI-X `boot: B8 virtio msi-x vec=21`, then `vda1 vda2 vda3` and `raynusrv2 login:`. Timer `linux PIT GSI 2`. `take11=0`. The `09b23c5d` boot had `ACPI MADT or MP tables are not detected` and `Using PIC`. virtio-net printed `PCI INT A: no GSI` for `00:05.0` because `_PRT` named only slots 2 and 3, and an RX completion signaled MSI-X queue 1. Follow-up confirmed on `64ddddafeffa` / run `42424856392`, pull-request merge of `9e3661fe`. DSDT length `0x11E`. `virtio-pci 0000:00:05.0: enabling device` with no `PCI INT A: no GSI`. Disk MSI-X `vec=21` again. Queue-notify COM2 lines stop at `n=961`. `systemd-networkd-wait-online` finished, `ssh.service` started, and `ssh vikkp@10.99.99.200` reached `vikkp@raynusrv2:~$`. Evidence `docs/evidence/r640/2026-11-08-64ddddaf-wave-7-b8-guest-ssh-ok.md`. Wave 7 stays open
